probe functions and opaque names are private fixture extensions
Trusted zero-argument producers are synchronous, not sandboxed
Payload size/depth/cycle admission complements patched AST budget; host callback wall-clock cost is not metered
State snapshot input is ready data; Variable scheduling/missing/pending/error propagation is not included
